limits: Controlled contributor fixture, not production permission support or a release-security claim.
Top-origin reachability is not requesting-frame authority; socket credentials alone cannot authorize application RPC.
Native-mediated remains the application baseline; loopback setup is rejected by ordinary native builds.
Small, local, non-quiet-machine distributions; no application startup advantage or platform-wide performance claim.
Kernel accounting is sampled provider-specific matched-identity lower bounds; Windows has no qualified provider.
Every failed trial remains failed; earlier reports missing receipts are not repaired retrospectively.
Persistent credential and full HTML5 storage-clear acceptance remain separate.
No cure for the historical intermittent CEF shutdown watchdog is inferred.
